Support

Get help opening documents, switching preview modes, and exporting PDFs. Email the developer if you run into a problem.

From Markdown to PDF

  1. Choose File › New or File › Open to edit a .md or .markdown document.
  2. Select Split in the toolbar to see the Markdown source and formatted preview side by side.
  3. Choose File › Export as PDF… or press Shift-Command-E. Select A4 or US Letter, choose a save location, and click Export.

Common questions

Which version of macOS do I need?

MarkToPage requires macOS 14.0 or later.

How do I change the PDF paper size?

Open the Export as PDF panel and select A4 or US Letter from the Paper Size menu.

Why did a heading, table, or code block move to the next page?

The exporter keeps headings with the content that follows and keeps tables and code blocks together when they fit on one page. Content longer than a page continues onto the next page.

Where can I find my exported PDF?

The PDF is saved to the location you chose in the export panel. When export finishes, you can also use Show in Finder or Open at the bottom of the app window.

Contact technical support

Include your macOS version, app version, a description of the problem, and steps to reproduce it. Remove private or confidential information from any sample you share.
